speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. To narrow down the cause, have you noticed any recent urinary frequency, urgency, or burning sensations during urination? Also, do you have a history of smoking or exposure to industrial chemicals like aniline dyes?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Hematuria and right flank pain. I also have History of recurrent urinary tract infections, No recent trauma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrolithiasis (Kidney Stone). Your history of recurrent UTIs and current symptoms of hematuria with right flank pain in a 42-year-old male is highly suggestive of a kidney stone, likely causing obstruction or irritation. I recommend a Non-Contrast CT of the Abdomen and Pelvis to confirm the presence and location of any calculi.
